image_state.basis: piecewise-constant cell averages as initial prototype; compare against refined integration, no claim of 2x physical resolution
image_state.output: sensor-area-integrated image on original native pixel grid
image_state.initialization: repeat native cell averages on 2x cells, exact native identity under integration

iterations.proposal: p_t = x_t + alpha_t R_theta(x_t, U(y), U(y-F_kappa(x_t)), calibration, local noise cues)
iterations.observation_step: one explicit local descent step from p_t on qualified observation discrepancy plus quadratic proximity to p_t
iterations.step_size_rule: positive and bounded by independently checked operator/likelihood curvature; no test-fitted coefficients

learned_prior.activation: SiLU; exact choice engineering proposal, not a validated advantage

forward_model.initial_family: local intensity PSF, pixel area integration, measured radiometric response and noise likelihood
forward_model.psf_centroid: measured calibration datum; cannot float per evaluated object or be silently recentered
forward_model.fallback_when_mismatched: report unqualified; direct reconstruction may remain an exploratory control, never relabel it as physics-qualified
forward_model.saturation: censored likelihood or explicit unsupported flag; never treat clipped value as exact latent truth

geometry.representation: general boundary likelihood and signed distance plus position/size uncertainty
geometry.role: training auxiliary and exposed diagnostic; does not freely warp or overwrite the image
geometry.supervision: independent synthetic geometry and, only when available, separately sourced real training SEM correspondences
geometry.image_consistency: two-way comparison of geometry and actual rendered image; independent external measurement remains decisive

tiling.halo_status: analytical design bound only; runtime impulse/gradient and tile tests still required

data_recipe.sequence_order: continuous object -> physical shift -> fixed within-sequence optics -> pixel integration -> radiometry/noise/quantization
data_recipe.coverage_policy: match observed real failure types, not fixed SEM evaluation shapes or copied evaluation pixels
data_recipe.real_training_extension: only new/source-disjoint acquisitions; noisy-repeat targets may teach denoising if independence holds, not unknown geometry or super-resolution truth
data_recipe.real_SEM_training_extension: only independent training objects; geometry supervision not SEM-to-optical grayscale copying

first_bounded_comparison.optimizer: AdamW, numerical proposal pending gradient and memory smoke checks
first_bounded_comparison.runtime_and_GPU_memory: not_measured; do not promise completion time

loss_contract.image: known optical target after native integration; foreground and texture strata retained separately
loss_contract.observation: qualified measured-noise likelihood in native sensor units
loss_contract.geometry: independent latent truth; never fit production objects to SEM answers
loss_contract.motion: known synthetic motion or source-disjoint independently measured real motion; real command alone not exact label
loss_contract.identity: no invented structure for already-correct/flat inputs
loss_contract.weights: freeze after implementation-only dimensional/gradient checks, before the first real candidate comparison; no tuning to synthetic position score

training_design.json.long_training: not_scheduled; requires real-development benefit with guards and a frozen follow-up hypothesis

validation_contract.json.primary_benefit: geometry and size under a calibrated microscopy-SEM correspondence, or a separately declared real measurement benefit; never sharpness alone

geometry.intended_primary: common-coordinate SEM boundary distance after independent readout qualification
geometry.until_mapping_qualified: ACM and half-contrast are noninterchangeable observations; contradictory directions mean unresolved, not success
geometry.legacy_and_pitch_matched_references: both retained as current sensitivity conditions, not alternative scores to choose after results
geometry.steepest_point: fixed settings with ambiguity and common coverage; never rescue an invalid primary population by dropping Raw

detail.full_restoration_claim_requires: independent optical reference or independently verified physical structures

identified_issues: Forward-residual input expands the iterative receptive field; initial 192 px halo insufficient.
Proximity gradient vanishes in a single step initialized at its reference proposal.
Repeat-and-average identity is not full-model identity under nonidentity optics.
Application promotion limits must be fixed before decision-bearing real outputs are seen.
Calibration-only independent ancestry may be shared within a calibrated-instrument claim.
Latent optical-intensity definition and informative training-core coverage must be explicit.
